description: OpenSearch 3.9.0: _id fielddata (indices.id_field_data.enabled defaults to true: sort, search_after, terms/composite/multi_terms/cardinality/value_count/significant_terms on _id, docvalue_fields and doc['_id'] in scripts; min/range refuse the _id type; turning the setting off refuses them again, cached aggregations included), script fields leaving _source out (search and top_hits), top_hits script_fields, and collapse field types. Changes the transient cluster setting indices.id_field_data.enabled (reset at the end): capture against a private OpenSearch node.
